tool.name: textract_ocr_tool
tool.description: Run this only for a DOCX or PDF page-plan entry with route=textract_ocr. It performs one low-cost Amazon Textract OCR pass on that page image and evaluates readability. When quality.status=passed, content_tree_uri is a schema-valid canonical BADGERS page spine and no Vision call is needed. When quality.status=escalate_to_vision, retain ocr_result_uri as audit evidence and run the normal BADGERS visual workflow on the same image_path.

image_path.description: S3 URI for the page image supplied by the DOCX or PDF page plan.

source_document_path.description: Optional S3 URI of the original DOCX or PDF document.

page_number.description: Original document page number; must be preserved in the returned page spine.

specialist.name: textract_ocr
specialist.description: Uses Amazon Textract as a low-volume OCR first pass and converts accepted output into a schema-valid BADGERS page spine.
